Strong wind gusts up to around 60 mph impacted a powerline and has left a large portion of Kivalina without power. Residents are being shuttled to the new school_ and about 175 people stayed there Friday night. It may be up to a week before power returns. They are prepping medical supplies in case they need to fly the injured to Kotzebue.
Six inches of snow fell at Nome Beltz Jr/Sr High School before transitioning to rain as of Friday evening around 6:30 PM.

Multiple public reports of coastal flooding in Hooper Bay with roads inundated_ impacting access to the airfield. Water levels per P-ETSS guidance shows a peak around 4 to 6 feet above the normal high tide line around 2 PM AKDT with gusts up to around 60 mph observed. Water levels are expected to drop to around 2 to 4 feet Friday night into Saturday.

Multiple public reports of coastal flooding in Teller with roads inundated and outlying structures impacted. Water levels per P-ETSS guidance show a peak around 3 to 5 feet above the normal high tide line Friday afternoon through Saturday with gusts up to around 60 mph observed. Water levels are expected to drop to around 2 to 4 feet Sunday into Monday.
